description: Generic lane dispatch — chạy nhiều lanes song song với Semaphore + backpressure. Lanes theo department/system/feature-group thay vì QD dimension.

inputs.name: lanes
inputs.notes: Danh sách lanes cần chạy, mỗi lane có key, agent_type, prompt, output_path.

inputs.name: max_parallel
inputs.notes: Semaphore limit, default 3. Lấy từ profile lanes_max_parallel.

outputs.name: lane_signal
outputs.notes: Mỗi lane ghi 1 file theo lane-signal-v1 schema

entry_points.command: from lane import dispatch_lanes, LaneConfig, LaneResult

testing.notes: Test dispatch empty/full, timeout, lane_signal write/read
